manifest.name: dsh-connect-sensenova-token-plan
manifest.description: One-tap connect SenseNova Token Plan language and image models into DSH (off by default), with image recognition and thinking level filled in automatically. On a rate limit it backs off and retries on its own instead of misreading it as an exhausted quota. After signing in to the SenseNova console you can see the usage pill, credit pools and per-model consumption. Xiaohuanxiong can also be signed in by QR code, bringing in its models and their consumption multipliers, and taking over DSH web search.

bundle.text:
# dsh-connect-sensenova-token-plan — the bundle's own patch layer.
#
# Reads the SenseNova Token Plan quota through the console API and shows it in
# a config card on the Plugins page (`plugins.bundle.config` slot) — not in the
# sidebar. Everything below is plain configuration: edit it here (or
# override the same id in the profile's cordis.patch.yml) and reinstall/reload.
#
# The console token is NOT configured here. Open the panel and sign in once:
# the Host logs in, keeps the account in the DSH credentials, and renews the
# token on its own from then on. See README.md.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-connect-sensenova-token-plan
      name: dsh-connect-sensenova-token-plan
      config:
        # Console origin. Override if you use a mirror or proxy.
        consoleBase: https://platform.sensenova.cn
        # The OpenAI-compatible API base, used only for the optional model
        # catalog (which models a pool can call). Leave it alone unless the
        # platform moves the endpoint.
        apiBase: https://token.sensenova.cn/v1
        # How many hours of per-model credit consumption to show (max 168 = 7d).
        trendHours: 24
        # Pseudo multipliers for the trend table: keys are case-insensitive
        # SUBSTRINGS of a model id (first match in writing order wins), values
        # are positive numbers. The platform returns raw credits with no
        # official per-model rate, so these are the operator's own comparison
        # aid — the panel labels each hit `×N` with a "not official" note, and
        # rows without a match stay unmultiplied. Set `{}` to disable all.
        # Invalid entries (empty key / value <= 0 / non-number) are dropped.
        trendMultipliers: { "glm-5.2": 10, "kimi-k3": 20, "sensenova": 1, "deepseek": 1 }
        # How long the Host caches each console response, in seconds.
        cacheSeconds: 60
        # How often the panel asks the Host again, in seconds. The Host states
        # this to the bundle on every snapshot, so the two cannot disagree about
        # how fresh the screen is.
        pollSeconds: 30
        # Deadline for one console call, in milliseconds. The login flow has its
        # own (loginTimeoutMs, below) because it walks several IAM hops.
        consoleTimeoutMs: 15000
        # Background freshness for a REGISTERED provider. The panel polls only
        # while it is open, but a registered provider is a standing execution
        # channel: while the EFFECTIVE provider switch is on, the Host drives
        # one aggregate refresh every N minutes (the same engine and cache the
        # panel's poll uses, so no extra upstream traffic within a cache
        # window). 0 disables it and keeps the panel-only shape. Every tick
        # re-reads the switch, so a Host that never registers a provider runs
        # no refresh at all. (2026-10 review #1b.)
        providerRefreshMinutes: 15
        # Renew the console token this many seconds before it actually expires,
        # so a poll never races the expiry boundary. 120 = two minutes.
        tokenSkewSeconds: 120
        # Extra host names this Host answers as, beyond the loopback defaults
        # (localhost / 127.0.0.1 / ::1). ADDED to them, never substituted — see
        # docs/SETUP.md. Uncomment and list to serve the panel from another name;
        # to open the panel from another machine on your LAN, list that address
        # (e.g. allowedHosts: ["172.19.0.199"]). Keep the fence on: it stops DNS
        # rebinding and cross-site writes to the credential routes (ADR-018).
        # allowedHosts: []
        # The rest of the login flow's endpoints. Everything below is optional:
        # a key left commented keeps the platform default. Only touch these for
        # an enterprise mirror or a staging tenant. Any endpoint that is not an
        # absolute http(s) URL fails the mount with code "config_error" instead
        # of surfacing later as a confusing network failure.
        # iamBase: https://iam.sensecoreapi.cn
        # tokenEndpoint: https://signin.sensecore.cn/oauth2/token
        # jwksEndpoint: https://signin.sensecore.cn/.well-known/jwks.json
        # redirectUri: https://platform.sensenova.cn
        # clientId: nova
        # scope: openid offline offline_access
        # encKeyId: public:hydra.openid.id-token
        # maxHops: 6
        # Overall deadline for one sign-in attempt (the multi-hop OIDC walk), in
        # ms. requestTimeoutMs below is its older spelling and still wins when
        # only it is set; the console calls use consoleTimeoutMs above.
        # loginTimeoutMs: 20000
        # requestTimeoutMs: 20000
        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Vision step two: publish which of this key's models accept image
        # input into this row's OWN settings namespace, for a later LLM
        # connect plugin (dsh-provider-sensenova, etc.) to read. It writes
        # only its own row - never another provider's imageModelIds - so a
        # miscalculated model list can only affect the panel, not DSH's
        # model routing.
        #
        # `writeImageModelIds: true`  -> the Host syncs visionModels into
        #   `imageModelIds` on this row's settings on every catalog poll
        #   (opt-in, off by default; the panel's read-only info layer is the
        #   safe shape).
        # `imageModelIds: []`         -> the last written model-id list.
        # `visionModels: []`          -> the last full vision identification
        #   (ids + source markers), kept for a reader that wants the detail.
        writeImageModelIds: false
        imageModelIds: []
        visionModels: []
        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Step three ("one-stop service"): register the SenseNova LLM
        # provider DIRECTLY, with no hand-written llm-pi-ai row. When true
        # the Host offers an OpenAI-compatible provider
        # (`sensenova-token-plan`, base apiBase above): the panel's API-key
        # field stores the `sk-` key in the DSH credentials (the process
        # environment still works as a fallback), the catalog poll builds
        # the model list, and vision models accept image input
        # automatically. The cached catalog and the model allow-list live
        # in this plugin's own state file, never on this row. Off by
        # default - registering a model source is a Host-wide change.
        # This value is now the DEPLOYMENT DEFAULT only: the panel's
        #「模型接入」switch (POST /api/<name>/provider) overrides it live,
        # with no restart. See docs/PROVIDER-HOT-RELOAD.md.
        registerProvider: false
        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Per-model OUTPUT CEILING overrides, keyed by EXACT model id (no
        # substring matching — unlike `trendMultipliers` above this becomes a
        # request parameter, so a loose key would silently retune models you
        # never named). Values are positive whole numbers of tokens.
        #
        # Why this exists at all: the catalog is FETCHED, not authored, and it
        # can understate a model. Probed 2026-10-02: `deepseek-v4-flash`
        # accepts 131072 while the catalog states 65536. Editing the stored
        # catalog does not stick — the next poll overwrites it — so a
        # correction has to live here.
        #
        # Precedence: this map > the catalog's `max_output_length` >
        # undeclared (the harness then applies its own `defaultMaxTokens ??
        # 32768`, so declaring nothing is NOT "no ceiling"). `{}` keeps the
        # platform authoritative. The panel's「最大输出」badge quotes the SAME
        # resolution, so the number you read is the number the request sends.
        # Applies to the directly-registered provider only; the Raccoon hosted
        # route builds its own descriptors.
        # maxTokensOverrides: { "deepseek-v4-flash": 131072 }
        maxTokensOverrides: {}
        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Draw absorption (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §5.4, route B): when true AND
        # the Host exposes a tools service, the agent gains a
        # `sensenova_draw_image` tool that POSTs to
        # `{apiBase}/images/generations` with the panel-saved
        # `SENSENOVA_API_KEY`. Draw models are identified from the catalog's
        # own `output_modalities` (never a name regex), the key is resolved
        # per call, and a failed draw starts a 30s cooldown. Off by default -
        # an agent tool is a Host-wide change; a Host without the tools
        # service simply never sees it.
        # drawEnabled: false
        #   -> the opt-in switch (strict boolean).
        # drawModelId: ""
        #   -> preferred image model id; empty = first of the catalog
        #      (e.g. sensenova-u1-fast).
        # drawTimeoutMs: 240000
        #   -> deadline for one image request (image models are slow);
        #      clamped into [5000, 1800000] (30 min is the ceiling).
        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Web-search absorption (docs/ROADMAP.md §6.1.7): when true AND the
        # Host exposes a `ctx.web` service, the Raccoon hosted `web_search` MCP
        # server is registered as a search provider, so DSH's own `web_search`
        # tool searches through it with the panel-signed-in Raccoon credential.
        # The plugin takes the search selection over (remembering whatever it
        # displaced) so a second provider does not raise WEB_PROVIDER_AMBIGUOUS.
        # Off by default - a search provider is a Host-wide change.
        # webSearchEnabled: false
        #   -> the opt-in switch (strict boolean).
        # ------------------------------------------------------------------

readme.text:
dsh-connect-sensenova-token-plan

把商汤（SenseNova）接进 DSH 的 Plugins 页插件卡，并在会话输入框实时显示积分额度与用量胶囊。

安装 · 工作原理 · 更新日志 · 问题反馈

把商汤接进 DSH 的 **Plugins 页**插件卡，另在会话输入框右侧常驻一颗用量胶囊。三个 tab 按使用顺序排列：

- **积分额度**——登录一次，实时查看积分余额、额度窗口与每模型消耗，令牌自动续期，之后无需再管；
- **接入 API**——把商汤模型注册为 DSH provider，参与对话与出图；
- **小浣熊**——微信扫码接入 `xiaohuanxiong.com`，上游限流较宽松的另一条商汤产品线，独立账号、独立积分。

后台另有 429 自愈：限频被误判为"额度耗尽"时在 Host 侧纠正回退避重试，模型不会无端"消失"。

> **AI 协作会话请先读 [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/eghrhegpe/dsh-connect-sensenova-token-plan/blob/master/AGENTS.md)**——验证入口、红线与文档地图都在那里；过程文档与提交历史本身就是本仓库工作面的一部分。
> 三个常被外部审读问起的疑问，预答在这里：
> - `lib/` 与根 `client.js` 是**入库的构建产物**：`github:` 安装源不跑 prepack，不入库则直装即坏（[docs/ADR.md](docs/ADR.md) ADR-005）
> - `docs/sensenova-api-reference/` 是商汤**官方文档的本地容器**，逐文件出处与许可见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)
> - 本仓库由 AI 协作开发，其提交历史里的过程痕迹是工作方式的一部分，不是疏漏
>
> **分发面**：npm 包只含 `package.json#files` 那 10 项（`lib/`、`client.js`、`icon.svg`、`locale/`、
> `cordis.patch.yml`、`README.md`、`CHANGELOG.md`、`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`、`LICENSE`、
> `screenshots.json`）。`docs/`、`AGENTS.md`、`src/`、`test/`、`assets/` **不在包里**——registry
> 页面上点 `docs/…` 会 404、写相对路径的截图会裂，所以本文的截图一律是
> `raw.githubusercontent.com` 绝对地址，细则链接请到 GitHub 仓库看。

把商汤 Token Plan 搬进 DSH，写代码时不用切网页就能盯住：

- **积分池**：额度窗口（已用 / 剩余 / 百分比 / 重置时间）、返赠余额与到期时间
- **模型清单**：套餐覆盖 vs 当前 Key 实际能调，一眼看出哪些模型需要开通
- **每模型消耗**：近 N 小时各模型积分排名，"烧分大户"一目了然

首次使用在「连接商汤控制台」填一次账号和密码，之后令牌自动续期。
- 登录失败时表单会直接显示商汤返回的原因（含「3 次错误锁 15 分钟」这类平台硬规则）；
- 想清除账号，用面板底部的按钮。

readme.section: ② 接入 API（可选，默认关）
readme.text:
把商汤模型注册为 DSH provider，参与对话与出图。
- 在「API Key」卡粘贴 `sk-` Key 保存后，Host 即以 `sensenova-token-plan` 之名注册 OpenAI 兼容 provider
- **语言模型**：模型列表随 `/v1/models` 自动刷新、可看图模型自动带图片输入；
- **出图工具**：Host 给 agent 注册工具 `sensenova_draw_image`；模型由 catalog 的 `output_modalities` 结构化判定。
- 开关、勾选与出图模型偏好都在面板热生效，无需重启**——**出图工具本身也在同一会话内随即挂载/卸载。细节见 [docs/SETUP.md](docs/SETUP.md) §4 与 [docs/PROVIDER-HOT-RELOAD.md](docs/PROVIDER-HOT-RELOAD.md)。

readme.section: ③ 小浣熊（可选，默认关）
readme.text:
微信扫码登录 `xiaohuanxiong.com` 网关，独立账号、独立积分余额。

- 上游限流较宽松，适合当作 Token Plan 硬配额池之外的日常通道
- 登录后显示积分余额与模型清单
- 每个模型带**上下文窗口 / 最大输出**与积分倍率（`free` / `×0.75` 这类，由网关目录声明；目录没给就不显示，不猜）
- **联网搜索**（默认关）：开启后 DSH 的 `web_search` 工具后端换成小浣熊托管的 MCP，复用小浣熊凭据，无需再单独配搜索端点 key

会话输入框右侧常驻一颗用量胶囊，直接显示当前模型正在烧谁的配额；点一下展开额度卡，看得到原始用量、精确重置时刻与池归属。

- 不是第四个 tab：面板关着它也在，切模型即换读数，永远不会显示上一个模型的额度
- 两档读数各自归口：商汤档读 5 小时 / 每周两个滚动窗口，小浣熊档读积分余额（网关未声明上限，不换算百分比）
- 套餐名前缀（`商汤 · ` / `浣熊 · `）说明下面的数字属于哪套额度
- 网关多了新模型时，小浣熊档的读数后面会挂一段 `· N 新模型`（名字在 tooltip 里，最多三个，7 天后自行消失）。这里的「新」是**本机第一次见到它**，不是上游的上架时间——网关目录没有这个字段；首次安装时整张名单按「早就见过」记，不会全报成新的

- 面板**不代你操作账务**：不改套餐、不代扣积分、不碰 Key 明文
- 数据来自商汤控制台自己的 API，与网页控制台口径一致
- 真正会「动」的四部分——注册 provider、挂出图工具、接第二个上游、切换联网搜索——全部 opt-in 且**默认关闭**，不打开时插件退化为纯信息展示

1. 在 DSH「插件」页搜索 `dsh-connect-sensenova-token-plan` 点击安装，或运行：

```powershell
   dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-connect-sensenova-token-plan       # Web 端
   dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-connect-sensenova-token-plan  # 桌面端
   ```

2. **完全退出 DSH（含托盘）再启动**。

3. 打开 DSH 的 **Plugins 页**，找到本插件的插件卡（面板是页内的内联卡片，**不在侧边栏**）。

找不到入口，或从局域网 IP 打开时面板报 `forbidden`？见 [docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md) D 节。

登录原理：

- Host 在后台用商汤标准登录拿令牌，并**自动续期**（refresh_token 到期前自动换新，所以不用你再输密码）
- 面板打开时才轮询一个只读本地路由，关掉即停
- 协议细节（OIDC/PKCE、密码 JWE 封包、防锁号节流）见 [docs/AUTH.md](docs/AUTH.md)，接口契约见 [docs/SENSENOVA-API.md](docs/SENSENOVA-API.md)

- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) — 架构与数据流
- [docs/SETUP.md](docs/SETUP.md) — 配置字段、改动后重启、常见信号
- [docs/AUTH.md](docs/AUTH.md) — 登录 / 续期 / 节流设计
- [docs/API.md](docs/API.md) — 路由与控制台端点
- [docs/TESTING.md](docs/TESTING.md) — 测试体系
- [docs/SENSENOVA-API.md](docs/SENSENOVA-API.md) — 商汤接口全集（实测）
- [docs/PITFALLS.md](docs/PITFALLS.md) — 真实踩坑（现象→根因→修法；条数见该文件头，别在这里写死）
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) — 版本变化
- [docs/README.md](docs/README.md) — docs/ 全量索引（含 ADR / ROADMAP / PROVIDER-HOT-RELOAD / TROUBLESHOOTING 等上表未列的）
> 装到 npm 的那一份 **不含 `docs/`**（`package.json` 的 `files` 白名单只带 `cordis.patch.yml` / README / CHANGELOG / THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES 等），上列 `docs/*` 链接在已安装副本上不可用，请到 GitHub 仓库看。

readme.section: 运维诊断：这台机器现在挂没挂 provider？
readme.text:
- 遇到问题先看 [docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)——它按**你看到的现象**组织（额度栏空的、反复要求登录、模型不出现、改了代码没生效…），而不是按主题；每条带稳定症状码，`doctor --json` 的 `symptoms` 字段直接给症状码，人和 agent 走同一条路。
- provider / 出图开关的生效值存在插件私有状态文件里，不在任何配置或路由上。按 profile 分段（见 `docs/PITFALLS.md` §23）：`$DSH_HOME/state/<profile>/<name>/`，取不到 profile 名时退回共享目录 `$DSH_HOME/state/<name>/`——查"到底开没开"用 doctor，它只读状态文件、不碰凭据，Host 没起也能跑：

readme.section: 运维诊断：这台机器现在挂没挂 provider？
readme.text:
```powershell
npm run doctor          # 人读：每个 profile 的 provider / draw 开关与模型清单
npm run doctor:json     # 机器读：JSON（可进你的巡检 / 工单脚本）
```

- 面板显示的是**控制台自己的口径**，与网页控制台一致；`GET /v1/models` 只区分权限，不计费也不占推理额度；
- 续期在令牌过期前触发；若 refresh_token 被吊销且环境里已无密码，面板会明确提示重新登录，而不是静默显示旧数据；
- 凭据（账号、access/refresh token）只经 DSH 凭据服务保存，**密码不落盘**；本插件不写任何明文凭据文件或调试日志。
